notes.title: Final update
notes.content:
The colors in the game have been updated and minor bugs have been eliminated, something has been added from the little things, the balance of the strength of the enemies has been slightly redone.
Unfortunately, some players may experience the problem of broken saves after the update.
Next, expect bigger updates with new locations and bosses.
